dialogues.speaker: Shajar
dialogues.text: Well, we've got too many outlanders here in Bayda Harbor, so some... diplomatic measures are necessary.

dialogues.speaker: Shajar
dialogues.text: I've got "friends" in Lumidouce Harbor and Yilong Wharf, so we exchange tips and such. Good deal as far as I'm concerned.

dialogues.speaker: Shajar
dialogues.text: *sigh* I'd originally come here to relax a bit. Didn't think this place would be as busy as Port Ormos...
